summary: Audio change is consistent with gate audio: -DFEATURE_SOUND plus stub SDL_mixer.h on the -I path, DG_sound_module/DG_music_module implemented with lazy per-lump DMX decoding, AudioContext created and resumed on keydown/pointerdown inside try/catch, key handler still calls preventDefault for mapped keys, and the export list is unchanged (six DG_TEST_ hooks). No blocking issues found; controller verification passed.

findings.evidence: platform/i_sound_web.c dg_audio_params(channel, vol, sep) only updates gain; sep is ignored
findings.summary: UpdateSoundParams does not update stereo pan, so moving sources keep their initial pan. Not covered by acceptance.

findings.evidence: audioUnlock() is called on every keydown, including unmapped keys, and only a pointerdown listener is added besides
findings.summary: Harmless but touches the context on each key event; resume is guarded by state check so there is no real cost.
